mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_category_id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.delete_flag, s.quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.product_category_id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.delete_flag, s.quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.product_category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id, p.product_category_id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.delete_flag, s.quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_category_id, name, price, image_url, delete_flag) VALUES (#{productCategoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{deleteFlag})
